title: The Fate Scribe
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji finally understood that the key to the Ultimate Hall lay within his own body, the gaze of the Heavenly Eye had descended—eight scrolls of schemes, the final moment approaches."

text.content: "At the end of the River of Destiny, Chen Ji's divine sense still drifted within those eyes that transcended everything. Those eyes held no emotion, no temperature, only the indifferent gaze overlooking all living beings—as if they had existed since antiquity, waiting for every ant who dared to pry into heavenly secrets."

"He did not retreat, but instead met that gaze. Within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly, as if warning, yet also anticipating. Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile was cold and sardonic—eight scrolls of schemes, eight years of concealment, he had long grown accustomed to being toyed with by 'Heavenly Will' between the palms of fate."

"Just then, within those infinite eyes, a silhouette slowly emerged. Pale contours, a form between reality and illusion, surrounded by dense threads of destiny, like a prisoner bound by countless chains of rules."

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had seen this figure—in the core of the Third Extremity forces, at every fluctuation of the River of Destiny, she had always existed, following like a shadow."

dialogue.content: "The Fate Scribe... no, should I say, her true form? Finally willing to reveal herself."

text.content: "That figure floated silently above the River of Destiny, the rule chains around her flickering with her breath. She did not respond to Chen Ji's words, only slowly raising her hand to point at her chest—where a faint Spiritual Light was pulsing."

"Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's warning echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'Be careful. The rule chains around her were carved by Chen Tianming himself. If not suppressed for three hundred years, she might have long lost control.'"

"Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. In the Third Extremity forces, he had clashed with the Fate Scribe several times, and she had always given him the feeling of being 'an executor of rules,' cold and mechanical. But now, the rule chains around her were clearly trembling—that was the tremor of a desire to break free."

"The Fate Scribe turned around, and Chen Ji finally saw her true face—a face without features, only silver-white light continuously flowing, like destiny itself being written. At her eyes, two deep vortices slowly rotated."

dialogue.content: "You are not a piece on the Heavenly Eye's chessboard. What are you...?"

text.content: "The Fate Scribe's voice sounded, without lip movements, without vibration, only cold words directly projected into the divine sense: 'Before Chen Tianming's fall, he剥离了a portion of his consciousness and created me. My duty is to supervise the execution of destiny—including you.'"

"Chen Ji's heart shook violently. Chen Tianming—the legendary predecessor of the Tianji Record who fell to Heavenly backlash, the existence whose bloodline brand had tormented him for eight years—had actually planted such a hidden piece before his fall?"

dialogue.content: "Supervising the execution of destiny... so for three hundred years, you have been monitoring me on behalf of Chen Tianming?"

text.content: "The Fate Scribe did not evade: 'Yes.' On her silver-white face, the trajectory of flowing light seemed to express some emotion—something Chen Ji could not comprehend. 'But now, I choose to betray him.'"

"Chen Ji sneered: 'Betrayal? A three-hundred-year chess piece suddenly wants to turn over a new leaf, you expect me to believe that?' His tone carried his usual sarcasm, but his mind was already racing—the Fate Scribe had countless opportunities to kill him if she wanted to."

"The Fate Scribe slowly shook her head, the rule chains around her clanking: 'The Heavenly Eye wants to reshape Heaven using all Tianji Record inheritors, Chen Tianming wants to use you to complete his unfinished revenge. And I—' her voice trembled for the first time, 'I no longer wish to be a chess piece.'"

choice.prompt: "The Fate Scribe proposes cooperation, Chen Ji must make a choice"

choices.description: "Choose to trust the Fate Scribe, accept her intelligence and assistance, and jointly oppose the Heavenly Eye"
choices.visible_cost: "Risk exposing the core secrets of the Tianji Record"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the Fate Scribe's key intelligence and destiny thread control abilities"
choices.risk_hint: "If she is still a trap, you will be beyond redemption"

text.content: "On the Fate Scribe's silver-white face, the trajectory of flowing light seemed to express some... relief? 'You have made the correct choice.' she said, 'The entrance to the Ultimate Hall is not in any external secret realm—it lies within your body.'"

"Chen Ji's heart shook violently. Within his body? The Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowed, as if corroborating her words. 'Chen Tianming carved the entrance to the Ultimate Hall into your Heavenly Fate,' she continued, 'Every time you use the Tianji Record, you are accumulating energy for that gate.'"

dialogue.content: "So from the very beginning, I have been used as a key?"

text.content: "The Fate Scribe nodded: 'Yes. But a key can also choose which door to open—this is your possibility for rebellion.' The rule chains around her tightened violently, her voice becoming urgent: 'The Heavenly Eye has already sensed my betrayal. Time is running out for us.'"

choices.memory_label: 接纳命运书写者成为盟友

choices.description: "Superficially accept cooperation, but actually stay vigilant, keep all cards and escape routes"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain strategic initiative, not bound by any force"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not immediately respond. In his Mental Sea, he exchanged a glance with Mo Xiansheng, the latter silent for a moment before transmitting a thought: 'The rule chains on this being are indeed carved by Chen Tianming's own hand, but what lies within... I cannot see through.'"

dialogue.content: "You say the entrance to the Ultimate Hall is within my body—evidence?"

text.content: "The Fate Scribe seemed to have anticipated this. She raised her hand and traced a line, and a destiny thread emerged from Chen Ji's chest, connecting to some indescribable depth. 'The consumption of your Heavenly Fate Value is essentially storing energy for the gate of the Ultimate Hall. When the energy is complete, the gate will open itself—at that time, whether you wish it or not, you will be devoured.'"

dialogue.content: "So I have two choices—passively devoured, or proactively enter to break Chen Tianming's control?"

text.content: "A flicker appeared on the Fate Scribe's silver-white face: 'You are indeed as Chen Tianming predicted, the best chess piece—and also the most dangerous variable.' She did not urge, only waiting silently. The River of Destiny surged behind her, reflecting all possibilities of choice."

choices.description: "Refuse cooperation with the Fate Scribe, she may be the final trap set by Chen Tianming or the Heavenly Eye"
choices.visible_reward: "Demonstrate an uncompromising stance, no existence can force Chen Ji to do anything"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying bone-deep coldness: 'Three hundred years as a chess piece, now claiming to want freedom? Fate Scribe, don't you think this excuse is too ridiculous?'"

dialogue.content: "Be it Chen Tianming's chess piece or the Heavenly Eye's chess piece—I, Chen Ji, will never be anyone's chess piece. You want cooperation? Fine. Prove your worth first."

text.content: "The rule chains around the Fate Scribe tightened violently, the light on her silver-white face fluctuated sharply. Chen Ji felt a majestic pressure surge like a tide—that was three hundred years of accumulated destiny power, enough to crush an ordinary cultivator to dust."

"But Chen Ji remained unmoved. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea emitted a low hum, a piece of information transmitted—her power was limited by the rule chains, she could only exert at most thirty percent. 'I was an undercover agent in the Third Extremity forces for three hundred years,' her voice carried emotion for the first time, 'Do you think I was waiting for nothing?'"

"Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. He noticed the rule chains around the Fate Scribe—those were bans carved by Chen Tianming himself, and now they were visibly disintegrating. 'You want to break free from your shackles?'"

"The Fate Scribe gave no answer. Her silver-white form began to become unstable, cracks appearing in the trajectory of flowing light. Chen Ji saw something flickering in the depths of those cracks—another pair of eyes, utterly different from the patterns on her surrounding rule chains."

dialogue.content: "What did Chen Tianming carve inside you?"

text.content: "'Partial authority over the Ultimate Hall,' her voice became ethereal, 'And... his final revenge trump card. When the Heavenly Eye attempts to devour you, this trump card will be activated—then, the entire world will be buried with him.'"

"Chen Ji understood. This was Chen Tianming's layout—he used the Fate Scribe he himself created as insurance, ensuring that no matter who obtained the Tianji Record inheritance, ultimately they would share mutual destruction with the Heavenly Eye. And he, Chen Ji, was merely the fuse to detonate all of this."

dialogue.content: "So you've come to me to get me to defuse this bomb for you? Chen Tianming's revenge cannot be completed by you?"

text.content: "On the Fate Scribe's silver-white face, that crack was growing larger. Her voice carried a hint of... plea? 'I can help you find Chen Nian. She is hidden by the Heavenly Eye in the deepest part of the Ultimate Hall—as the final puzzle piece to restart Heaven.'"

"Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned ice-cold. Chen Nian—his missing sister for years, one of the true reasons behind his eight-scroll scheme. The Fate Scribe clearly knew this, which suddenly increased the credibility of her words."

choice.prompt: "The Fate Scribe knows more about Chen Nian"

choices.description: "Completely believe what the Fate Scribe said, acknowledge that Chen Tianming's schemes are far deeper than imagined"
choices.visible_cost: "Fundamentally overturn understanding of the Tianji Record"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the location of the Ultimate Hall entrance, and the possibility of saving Chen Nian"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be crueler than imagined"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled more intensely, as if responding to destiny's call. 'Chen Tianming...' he murmured, his voice carrying complex emotions, 'Turns out from the very beginning, I was not playing a game against the Heavenly Eye.'"
"The Fate Scribe's voice became gentle—if a faceless existence could be described as gentle: 'You are stronger than Chen Tianming. Because you possess something he could never have—bonds.'"

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian... and all the people who trusted me along this journey."

text.content: "'The River of Destiny has never recorded their existence,' the Fate Scribe pointed to Chen Ji's heart, 'Because your bonds have become powerful enough to distort the course of destiny. This is what the Heavenly Eye truly fears—not the Tianji Record in your hands, but the connections you have forged with this world.'"

choices.description: "Do not easily believe any 'truth', require the Fate Scribe to prove her sincerity with actions"
choices.visible_reward: "Test the Fate Scribe's bottom line, gain more negotiating chips"

text.content: "Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze恢复了his usual calmness and calculation: 'Nice words. A three-hundred-year chess piece suddenly wants to turn over a new leaf, how do you expect me to believe?' He extended his hand, 'Give me a reason—one I must believe you.'"

"The Fate Scribe fell silent for a moment. Then, one of the rule chains around her violently snapped, and from the cracks on her silver-white face, a dazzling light burst forth. Within that light, Chen Ji saw an image—Chen Nian trapped in a cage woven from destiny threads, eyes closed, a symbol similar to the Tianji Record flickering on her brow center."

"'This is the Heavenly Eye's core prison,' the Fate Scribe's voice was somewhat weak, clearly this display had cost her much strength, 'Only I can lead you in. And you—' she pointed to Chen Ji's heart, 'Need to do is open the gate of the Ultimate Hall.'"

"Chen Ji fell silent. In his Mental Sea, both the Tianji Record Fragment and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul vibrated simultaneously, seemingly responding to some ancient call. He suddenly realized—from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, everything had been converging toward this endpoint."

"'The key to the Ultimate Hall has always been in your own hands.' the Fate Scribe said finally. Her form was dissipating, most of the rule chains had already snapped. The River of Destiny roared behind her, seemingly declaring some irreversible outcome."

"Chen Ji watched that dissipating figure, and suddenly spoke: 'Fate Scribe—no, what should I call you?' Her answer came from all directions, carrying an emotion he had never heard before: 'Call me... Freedom.'"

"Her form completely vanished. But at the place where she disappeared, a wisp of silver-white thread fell into Chen Ji's palm—that was the Fate Scribe's gift, and also proof of her choice. The thread was warm in his hand, as if alive, coiling around his fingers."

"Chen Ji held that wisp of thread, his gaze profound. The entrance to the Ultimate Hall was within his body, Chen Nian was trapped at the Heavenly Eye's core, and the Tianji Record Fragment within him—at this moment, was trembling more intensely than ever, as if responding to destiny's call."

"Eight scrolls of schemes, the final moment approaches. A cold smirk appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth—whether Chen Tianming's revenge or the Heavenly Eye's schemes, none would make Chen Ji a chess piece. This time, he would be the Chess Player."

"Just then, in the depths of the River of Destiny, those indifferent eyes that transcended everything opened once more. The Heavenly Eye—it had finally focused its gaze on Chen Ji. And this time, that gaze was no longer distant observation, but carried substantive pressure, as if Heaven itself was declaring judgment."

"Chen Ji felt that pressure, yet showed no fear whatsoever. He stored the silver-white thread in his palm into his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment's light merging with that wisp of thread, weaving a brand-new rune in his divine sense sea—that was the mark of 'Freedom.'"

"'Come then.' Chen Ji murmured, his voice carrying a determination he had never possessed in eight years, 'Heaven wishes to destroy me, I shall instead defy Heaven and change my fate. The gate of the Ultimate Hall—I, Chen Ji, open it!'"

"The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with brilliant light, a dormant mechanism within Chen Ji's body was triggered—a mark hidden in the depths of his bloodline, now slowly emerging, outlining the silhouette of a gate. The entrance to the Ultimate Hall truly lay within his own body."

"Chen Ji's divine sense was drawn toward that gate, in a daze, he saw the other side of the gate—in endless darkness, Chen Nian's figure was faintly visible, reaching out to him for help. And behind her, a pair of indifferent eyes of the same origin as Chen Ji, were slowly emerging."
